Plan check: five call-path lines cite a file with no line number, so they are unverified
The final preset-free build was not re-run through a real agent session; the hooks-only bench ran on the branch before the preset was deleted, with the preset simply not installed
Two webview suites cannot load in this worktree because node_modules is absent here; they are untouched by this change and run in CI
The bench harness in speckit-sandboxes still installs companion-standard for its Companion arms and will fail to bake until its PRESET_BY_MODE is cleared
Worker task finishes had to use --kind=complete: the worktree shell guard reads --kind complete as the shell builtin

Doctor: task finishes were journaled in bursts (worker results closed together at wave joins), and three capture calls failed without an outcome during the worktree shell-guard refusals; both are this run's own handling, not product defects
